open_points.subject: A20 rule 3 Linux-only release and surface startup
open_points.text: A release runs on Linux and on no other host, no version named
open_points.question: What exactly qualifies as a supported Linux host, and which release or startup operation prevents execution on every other host, with what observable failure?
options: A release artifact is produced only for Linux, with no runtime host check
surface.serve_kernel performs a runtime Linux check and stops startup with a specified refusal
Support is capability-based on Linux, with required kernel facilities and their startup checks explicitly listed
open_points.default_guess: Ship Linux-only artifacts and let surface.serve_kernel stop startup as unsupported if invoked on a non-Linux kernel.
